## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (DCO) — see `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] This PR touches exactly one RFC / one specification document / one
      clearly-scoped documentation fix (see "Scope discipline" in
      `CONTRIBUTING.md`).
- [ ] If this is a normative change, it is proposed as an RFC, not a direct
      edit to `specification/` — see `rfcs/README.md`.
- [ ] If this changes or introduces a term, `docs/GLOSSARY.md` is updated
      in the same PR (or explicitly deferred to the originating RFC).
